description: ADR-0120 D12 SUPPLEMENTAL scored corpus, selector-only (owner decision (가) option 1 of 2026-10-27): the 12 conversation-context cases of owner decision D1 and context-eval fix P7 (2026-10-26, nl-select.v68), agent-drafted 2026-10-26 and owner-approved as-is in the D12 batch of 2026-10-26; ctx-d1-005's text swapped by owner decision (나) of 2026-10-27, and ctx-p7-002's and ctx-d1-002's by the owner's pick of 2026-10-27 (ADR-0123 near duplicates; expectations and priors unchanged). The 34 D4 cases (ctx-d4-001..034, owner-approved) moved to nl-intent.context-d4-pending.v1.json by the owner decision of 2026-10-27: D4 moves to the next merge as a dedicated classifier with its own eval and gate. Scope: `eval:nl` (read) and `eval:nl --mode read-regression` score these cases together with nl-intent.v1.json, and they count in both gates (per-entry, overall and wrong captures). They are NOT part of the ADR-0121 Q11 one-step planner gold (Q11 auto-includes nl-intent.v1.json only; the planner does not yet receive the listing context, an S2 activation blocker in DECISIONS). ADR-0123 applies: the selector-RAG pool lint and the embedding audit check them (overlap only; they are not in the RAG experiment split). Same schema as nl-intent.v1.json plus: `prior.turns` (chat turns since the previous listing) and `prior.earlier` (the latest selection of each other source; an output for an earlier entry is grounded against it). Rendered exactly as the runtime renders them.
